items.Title: Chicken & Veggie Fritters with Mushrooms
items.Desc: Crispy golden fritters made with ground chicken, zucchini, bell pepper, onion, and mushrooms.

items.Title: Chicken Bowl with Rice and Vegetables
items.Desc: Balanced lunch: rice, chicken in teriyaki-light sauce, crunchy vegetables and egg, sprinkled with sesame.

items.Title: Chicken Breast Roll with Omelet
items.Desc: A rolled chicken breast stuffed with a creamy omelet and leek, baked in foil. Serve in warm or chilled slices.

items.Title: Chicken Breast in Mustard Cream Sauce with Rice
items.Desc: Sliced chicken breast in a tangy cream-mustard sauce with caramelized onions, served over steamed rice.

items.Title: Chicken Breast with Broccoli and Brown Rice
items.Desc: Healthy lunch with protein, vegetables and whole-grain rice, boosted with a yogurt-garlic-lemon sauce.

items.Title: Chicken Breast with Mozzarella and Tomato
items.Desc: Chicken fillet stuffed with melted mozzarella and juicy tomato. This protein-packed dish is easy to prepare.
